lines: I won't forget the promise we made
I close my eyes and confirm it
Brushing off the darkness that surged at me, I press on
When will I be able to see again
the future I lost, here with me?
Again and again I tear through the shadows of anxiety welling up
and walk on through this world
The time carved out without end now announces a beginning
carrying feelings that never change
Let's open the sealed door
My awakened heart has started running, to draw the future
Even if I stop on a hard road
the sky is always waiting for me in its beautiful blue
So I'm not afraid
Nothing can break me anymore
When I look back, my friends are there
Before I knew it, I was wrapped in kindness
In a world where everything is twisted
this was the one place I could believe in, and it saved me
Joy and sorrow, when shared, deepen into stronger longing
If this voice can reach you
surely I can work a miracle
I won't forget the promise we made
I close my eyes and confirm it
Brushing off the darkness that surged at me, I press on
No matter how great the wall in my way
I will climb over it, surely
Believing in tomorrow, praying
I wandered through a broken world
and arrived as if drawn here
My awakened heart has started running, to draw the future
Even if I stop on a hard road
the sky is always waiting for me in its beautiful blue
So I'm not afraid
Nothing can break me anymore
Tomorrow will always be waiting
